name: Wrack Abishai
tactics: A wrack abishai begins an attack by blasting its opponents with acidic burst, then closes to deliver its vicious sting, using deadly ambush against a blinded target. Wrack abishais use hit-and-run tactics, darting out to attack blinded foes, and retreating as their enemies recover. They turn invisible with shadow meld to use deadly ambush if unable to blind enemies.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Deadly Ambush
traits.details: The wrack abishai deals 1d10 extra damage to a target that cannot see it, and that target is dazed (save ends).

hit.description: acid damage, and the target is pushed 3 squares and blinded (save ends)

effect.description: The wrack abishai turns invisible and moves 6 squares. It remains invisible until the end of its next turn.
